From: Tina Lopez <t.lopez@nimblefleet.com>

Cc: procure@nimblefleet.com
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding paperwork + PO needed to start provisioning

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. We're ready to accept the integration window but need the official PO and the account spend cap set before we route invoices to finance. The draft order we uploaded references three SKUs but the quantities were entered as estimates by our AE — we'll need final line quantities attached to the PO.

Can you confirm: 
- PO number issuance timeline (we're aiming to provision next Tuesday)
- Whether spend cap can be opened to the provisional $75k band while we complete SOC review
- Any required changes to line item descriptions for matching with our ERP (we use NetLedger)

I've attached our completed vendor onboarding form and the internal requisition. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Tina Lopez
Procurement Lead | NimbusFleet
(t) 415-555-0192

Attachments: nimblefleet_onboarding_form_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), nq-requisition.pdf (ref)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tina Lopez <t.lopez@nimblefleet.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 10:03:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding paperwork + PO needed to start provisioning

Hi Tina — thanks for sending the form. Quick answers below, and copying Ben in procurement and Priya in finance to lock the PO number and provisional spend band.

- Timeline: We can issue a provisional PO number within 1 business day once procurement confirms final line quantities and the vendor W9 is in our vendor record. Final signed PO will follow once finance confirms spendband gating.
- Spend cap: We can provisionally open to $75,000 for the first 30 days pending SOC docs. Finance needs a written acceptance of provisional cap from Nimbus (email OK).
- Line items: Please change the SKU descriptions to include your internal SKU (NetLedger ID) in parentheses after the Redwood SKU so invoice matching is deterministic. Example: "Redwood-API-Std (NF-12345)".

Action items: 
1) Tina: Reply with final line quantities and confirm acceptance of provisional cap in writing.
2) Ben: Once quantities confirmed, please allocate a provisional PO token and assign an initial PO number into the ledger system.
3) Priya: Please review for a 30-day provisional spendband and confirm GL mapping.

Marissa
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

--
